questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: ग्रेट भिक्टोरिया मरुभूमि कुन देशमा पर्छ?
questions.explanation: ग्रेट भिक्टोरिया मरुभूमि अष्ट्रेलियाको ठूलो आन्तरिक शुष्क क्षेत्रमा पर्छ।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: नेपालको भौतिक भूगोलसम्बन्धी कुन कथन सही छ?
options: नेपालको सम्पूर्ण भूभाग समान उचाइमा छ
नेपालको भौगोलिक बनोटमा हिमाल, पहाड र तराईका प्रमुख प्रदेशीय भिन्नता देखिन्छ
तराई क्षेत्र हिमाली क्षेत्रभन्दा सामान्यतः धेरै उच्च उचाइमा छ
questions.explanation: नेपालमा उचाइ, भू-आकृति र जलवायुका आधारमा हिमाल, पहाड र तराईका प्रमुख भौगोलिक क्षेत्र देखिन्छन्।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: जोडा मिलाउँदा कुन विकल्प सही छ?
options: Caspian Sea — संसारको सबैभन्दा ठूलो बन्द जलाशय/तालको रूपमा परिचित
Lake Baikal — अफ्रिकाको सबैभन्दा ठूलो ताल
questions.explanation: Caspian Sea नाम भए पनि भौगोलिक रूपमा ठूलो बन्द जलाशय हो र विश्वकै सबैभन्दा ठूलो lake का रूपमा पनि वर्णन गरिन्छ।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: पाम्पास घाँसे मैदान कुन क्षेत्रमा प्रसिद्ध छ?
questions.explanation: पाम्पास दक्षिण अमेरिकाको दक्षिणपूर्वी भाग, विशेषतः अर्जेन्टिनासँग सम्बन्धित उर्वर घाँसे मैदान हो।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: A — अर्जेन्टिना र आसपासको दक्षिण अमेरिका।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: जोडा मिलाउँदा कुन विकल्प सही छ?
options: हिमाल — उच्च उचाइ र हिमाली भू-दृश्यसँग सम्बन्धित क्षेत्र
questions.explanation: नेपालको हिमाली क्षेत्र उच्च उचाइ, हिमाच्छादित पर्वत र विशिष्ट हिमाली भू-दृश्यसँग सम्बन्धित छ।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: जनसंख्या र प्राकृतिक स्रोतबीचको सम्बन्धबारे कुन कथन बढी उपयुक्त छ?
options: जनसंख्या र स्रोतबीच कुनै सम्बन्ध हुँदैन
जनसंख्या वृद्धि र स्रोतको मागबीच सम्बन्ध हुन्छ, त्यसैले पानी, भूमि र ऊर्जा व्यवस्थापन महत्वपूर्ण हुन्छ
सहरीकरणले पानी र ऊर्जाको माग बदल्दैन
questions.explanation: जनसंख्या, शहरीकरण र आर्थिक गतिविधि बढ्दा पानी, भूमि, ऊर्जा तथा अन्य स्रोतको माग र व्यवस्थापन चुनौती बदलिन सक्छ।

questions.subject: आदिवासी जनजाति
questions.q: नेपालमा आदिवासी जनजाति सूचीसम्बन्धी प्रश्नमा कुन संस्था विशेष रूपमा सम्बन्धित छ?
questions.explanation: आदिवासी जनजाति सम्बन्धी विषयमा प्रतिष्ठान प्रमुख सम्बन्धित संस्थामध्ये एक हो।

questions.subject: इतिहास

questions.explanation: 1868 को मेइजी पुनर्स्थापनाले जापानको राजनीतिक तथा आधुनिकीकरण प्रक्रियालाई तीव्र बनायो।

questions.subject: आदिवासी जनजाति
questions.q: तामाङ भाषा तथा साहित्यमा कविता, गीत, उपन्यास र महाकाव्यलगायत सिर्जना गर्ने साहित्यकारका रूपमा मातृभाषा राष्ट्रिय सेवा पुरस्कार पाउने व्यक्ति को हुन्?
questions.explanation: प्रतिष्ठानको विवरणअनुसार योगेश राल्फालीलाई मातृभाषा राष्ट्रिय सेवा पुरस्कार प्रदान गरिएको थियो।

questions.subject: आदिवासी जनजाति
questions.q: नेवार समुदायबारे कुन कथन सबैभन्दा उपयुक्त छ?

नेपालभाषाले भाषिक एकता दिएको मिश्रित सामाजिक तथा धार्मिक समुदाय हो
नेवार समुदायमा गुठीको सांस्कृतिक भूमिका छैन
questions.explanation: प्रतिष्ठानको विवरणले नेवारलाई विविध सामाजिक तथा धार्मिक पृष्ठभूमि भएको समुदायका रूपमा र नेपालभाषालाई साझा भाषिक सूत्रका रूपमा वर्णन गर्छ।

questions.subject: इतिहास

questions.explanation: 1789 को घोषणाले स्वतन्त्रता, समानता र अधिकारका सिद्धान्तलाई अघि बढायो।

A woman says, 'The man is the brother of the only daughter of my mother.' How is the man related to the woman?
questions.solution: Her mother's only daughter is herself; the man is her brother.

'red blue green'='ka la ma' and 'blue yellow'='la pa'. What is the code for blue?
questions.solution: Blue is the common word and la the common code.

questions.question: If CAT is coded as DBU, how is DOG coded?
questions.solution: Each letter moves one place forward.

questions.question: Is n even? I n is divisible by 4. II n is divisible by 2. Which is sufficient?
questions.solution: Either statement establishes that n is even.

questions.question: Find the next number: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.solution: The terms are n(n+1); the sixth is 6×7=42.

questions.question: Which option is the right-side mirror image?
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. The order reverses and the arrow direction becomes left.

questions.question: Which simple figure is embedded?
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. The inner outline is a square.

questions.question: Joining the two equal squares side by side forms which figure?
options: A rectangle twice as wide as high
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Two equal squares side by side form a rectangle with a 2:1 width-to-height ratio.

questions.q: आकृतिहरूको क्रम हेरी प्रश्नचिह्न (?) को स्थानमा आउने सही आकृति छान्नुहोस्।
questions.question: आकृतिहरूको क्रम हेरी प्रश्नचिह्न (?) को स्थानमा आउने सही आकृति छान्नुहोस्।
questions.solution: A-B-B-A क्रम दोहोरिन्छ; अर्को वृत्त हो।

questions.question: Which comes next?
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Each direction appears twice before rotating 90° clockwise; after ↓↓ comes ←.

questions.question: If x/5 = 12, what is x?
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. Multiply both sides by 5.

questions.question: The simple interest on Rs. 5,000 at 8% per annum for 3 years is:
Is x greater than 10? Statement I: x = 12. Statement II: x is an even number.
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Statement I directly establishes x = 12.

questions.question: A salary is increased by 15% and then decreased by 10%. The net percentage change is:
A train travels 360 km at 72 km/h. The travel time is:
Find the next number: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?.
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. Terms are n(n+1): 1×2, 2×3, ...; next is 6×7 = 42.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Six books P, Q, R, S, T and U are arranged left to right. P is left of Q. R is immediately right of S. T is between Q and U. Which arrangement is possible?
options: Q P T U S R
P T Q U S R
P Q U T S R
P Q T U S R
questions.solution: P-Q-T-U-S-R satisfies P before Q, R immediately after S, and T between Q and U.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Four interviews P, Q, R and S are scheduled in four slots. Q is before R. S is immediately after P. R is not last. Which sequence is valid?
questions.solution: Q-P-S-R satisfies Q before R, S immediately after P, and R is last—so it violates R not last. Therefore none? Check options: P-S-Q-R also has R last; P-Q-S-R has R last; S-P-Q-R has S not after P. Hence no sequence is valid.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statements: No inspectors are clerks. Some clerks are accountants. Conclusions: I. Some accountants are not inspectors. II. No accountant is an inspector.
questions.solution: The clerks who are accountants cannot be inspectors, so some accountants are not inspectors. Nothing establishes that every accountant is a clerk.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A school notices a sudden increase in absenteeism. Courses of action: I. Examine attendance records and consult students and families. II. Punish every absent student immediately without investigation.
questions.solution: Fact-finding is appropriate before deciding on interventions. Blanket punishment without understanding causes is not.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A public office receives repeated complaints that citizens cannot easily find its service requirements online. Courses of action: I. Redesign the information page using clear headings and a checklist. II. Stop publishing service requirements online.
questions.solution: Improving clarity addresses the complaint; removing information would worsen access.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: An agency's emergency procurement records show repeated missing justifications. Which course is most appropriate first?
options: Review the cases, identify the control failure, and require documented justification
Ignore the issue because emergencies are unpredictable
questions.solution: A targeted review can identify the weakness and lead to corrective controls without abandoning necessary emergency procurement.

questions.passage: Putting a paper form online does not ensure good digital service. Users also need clear instructions, accessibility, privacy, mobile usability and reliable support. Success means completing a task accurately with reasonable effort.
questions.question: Good digital service should consider
questions.solution: The passage says users need support across the service experience.

questions.passage: Disaster preparedness begins before a crisis through risk identification, communication, evacuation practice and supplies. Plans may fail under unexpected conditions, so post-event review should improve future planning.
questions.question: Which statement is TRUE?
questions.solution: Prior planning and review can improve response.

questions.passage: A percentage can mislead if its denominator or comparison period is unclear. Readers should examine what was measured, how it was measured and the baseline. Graphs communicate trends but do not replace underlying data.
questions.question: What should a reader check when interpreting a percentage?
questions.solution: The passage warns about denominator and comparison period.

questions.passage: Urban parks provide shade, absorb some rainwater and support recreation. Their benefits depend on location, maintenance, accessibility and safety, not merely on the amount of green space.
questions.question: What broader conclusion follows?
options: Design affects whether benefits are realised
questions.solution: The passage stresses planning and design.

questions.passage: Road widening can increase capacity, but extra private-vehicle trips may absorb it. Public transport, walking facilities and land-use planning can influence travel choices. Congestion policy should consider both infrastructure and demand.
questions.question: Why may congestion return after road widening?
questions.solution: Additional private-vehicle demand may absorb new capacity.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The committee's decision was based on professional _____.
questions.solution: “advice” is the noun meaning guidance; “advise” is the corresponding verb.

questions.question: Choose the correct adjective form of “benefit” in “a _____ arrangement”.
questions.solution: “beneficial” is the correct derived form required by the sentence.

questions.question: In “The policy may have unintended consequences,” what does “unintended” mean?
questions.solution: The context indicates that “not planned or intended” is the intended meaning.

questions.question: Choose the correct adjective form of “economy” in “_____ growth”.
questions.solution: “economic” is the correct derived form required by the sentence.

questions.question: A statement that contradicts itself is a
A person who strongly opposes a particular policy is a
Choose the word opposite in meaning to “rational”.
Choose the clearest sentence.
options: The officer reviewed the file carefully that contained errors.
The officer reviewed carefully the file contained errors.
The officer the file reviewed carefully that contained errors.
The officer carefully reviewed the file that contained errors.
questions.solution: The modifier carefully is naturally placed before the verb phrase, and the relative clause clearly modifies file.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'The department ___ budget was reduced requested an explanation.'
questions.solution: Whose expresses possession: the department's budget.

questions.question: The meeting starts ___ 10 a.m. ___ Monday.
questions.solution: At is used for clock time and on for a particular day.

questions.question: By 2030, the agency ___ the digital system for several years.
questions.solution: An action continuing up to a future point takes future perfect continuous.

questions.question: The teacher said, 'I am checking the papers.' Choose the correct reported form.
options: The teacher said that I am checking the papers.
The teacher said that she is checking the papers tomorrow.
The teacher said that she was checking the papers.
The teacher said that she had checked the papers.
questions.solution: Present continuous normally shifts to past continuous in reported speech.

questions.question: This time next month, they ___ the new bridge.
questions.solution: A completed action expected before a future point takes the future perfect.

questions.question: The new policy aims to reduce costs, improve service and ___.
questions.solution: The three coordinated verbs should be parallel: reduce, improve, increase.

questions.question: Each of the proposals ___ carefully examined before approval.
questions.solution: Each is singular and therefore takes was.
